Brant Point Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Mohawk Inds Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $16.20B market cap company. (NYSE:MHK) has risen 0.12% since April 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.43% the S&P500.
